items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Jonah Jones was in the band. Yeah, he was there when I went there.

ctx.x: Was Jonah Jones in that band?

Yeah, Jonah Jones was in the band. Yeah, he was there when I went there. So they ignored Diz. I said, “Diz, come on with me,” because we was friends from New York. A little small friendship. I remember I had to try to pull that deal with him on, with Lucky Millinder. So Dizzy and I had a room together. You see me and Dizzy sleeping on the bus together. You see that picture?

items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jonah Jones, we’s talking a while, he said, “Man, you sure was missed in that band.” ... Jonah done told me, say, “Man, you was missing.”

ctx.x: Yeah, and that’s what the band want. They had a quartet used to go out front. Chu Berry, Tyree Glenn, Cozy Cole, myself, and Hinton. Five. A quintet. They called it Cab Jivers. We would go out. Chu Berry’s up front. Jonah Jones up front. Tyree Glenn with the vibraphone. Me and Hinton’s in the back. The show don’t last that long for you to stay out there no 15 minutes playing no jam session. So you do your thing, but Chu Berry used to hog up the whole scene. Now what I look like grabbing a solo behind that? You…

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Jonah Jones, too. He'd always find out the chef... Jonah had a waiter in the Sherman Hotel... Jonah used to (?)tell us(?) to make them spitballs... we liked him

ctx.x: The chef. You know, when we'd be on those long trips.

Yeah. Yeah, well, they had a thing... They was big eaters, them boys. Jonah Jones, too. He'd always find out the chef. Anywhere there was a cook, there was Jonah Jones. He would get with the waiters, and the waiters were always bringing him a half-a-steak, and you'd see Jonah in the corner with a plate, and he'd be eating, and these chicks... You know, you're out there, and you're missing the good food. But Jonah had a waiter in the Sherman Hotel who used to bring Jonah, oh, half a steak maybe three times a…
Hey, Danny, what's that place we used to play in Boston?
